decisions.evidence: Accepted the reader clarification after comparing the exact archived pre-reader bytes (SHA-256 ec31817551a41f1bcf758615f70c7f51b62eed180d50ba230eeee89c994d4088) with the current carrier matching the post-reader SHA-256 d88c2e30db4e8e1335ce81c089dca139f6c35e61266cb4151404d665cd7e647f. The old witness left absence of multisite terms implicit; the repair explicitly adopts the onsite-only supplier interaction and sets Phi(Z)=0 on every finite nonempty support, giving H_Lambda=0 and alpha_t=id. The unital representation gives a bounded normalized positive vector state; E01 E10 and E10 E01 have expectations 1 and 0. Bounded-strip lower-edge uniqueness contradicts the KMS upper edge for every beta>0. The refuted Statement and all dependency interfaces are unchanged; a search of items and pages found only the B-page placement and no logical/reference consumer of this counterexample.
